searchText: Hey guys! I have a doubt regarding reorgs, don't know where to ask so asking here. Is there a possibility of long reorg happening in ethereum PoS of greater than 2 epochs? Or since the blocks deeper than 2 epochs are considered finalised, it is impossible? Tagging <@539495253418180618> for visibility 🙏 In theory, anything that isn't finalized can reorg. And there is no hard guarantee on time to finality (the chain can, in theory, fail to finalize indefinitely). Pragmatically, finality will probably happen on schedule except during an attack and reorgs probably won't be more than a handful of blocks deep.
